semiconductor_relevance: High — JUcan is a key supplier of electrical distribution systems and monitoring solutions specifically tailored for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: JUcan Co., Ltd. is Taiwan's leading provider of electrical distribution boards and related installation services for semiconductor equipment. They specialize in heavy-duty power distribution, low-voltage systems, and monitoring solutions, offering a comprehensive one-stop service to optimize operational efficiency.

regional_presence.Taiwan: JUcan is the number one supplier of electrical distribution boards in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor industry.
